---

### Typical DNS Record Types You Might Find for `site.info`

| Record Type | What It Represents |
|-------------|--------------------|
| **A**       | IPv4 address(es) pointing to the web server(s). |
| **AAAA**    | IPv6 address(es), if configured. |
| **MX**      | Mail exchange servers responsible for handling email sent to addresses at `@site.info`. |
| **NS**      | Nameserver delegation – who controls the zone. |
| **TXT**     | Arbitrary text strings used for SPF, DKIM, DMARC, verification tokens, etc. |
| **CNAME**   | Canonical names aliasing other hostnames (rarely used at the apex domain level). |
| **SOA**     | Start Of Authority record – contains administrative information about the zone. |

> **Note:** For many public domains, the apex (`site.info`) often has just one or two A/AAAA records plus the standard NS/SOA set. Additional records may appear depending on mail setup, subdomains, CDN usage, security policies, etc.


| `nslookup -query=any site.info` | Alternative lookup method. |
| Cloud provider APIs (e.g., AWS Route 53, Google Cloud DNS) | Programmatic retrieval of zone data. |
